get.description: The signed-in user and their workspaces. Provisions the user on first call (AC5).
A bundled document schema (no tenant data), for the review form (F7 plan §3).
A workspace the caller belongs to. Anything else is 404 (AC15).

patch.description: Rename a workspace. Admins only (AC16, AC17).

get.description: Every provider, connected or not (AC3). Never includes the keys (AC4).

put.description: Check the key with its provider, then store it encrypted (AC1, AC8).

post.description: Approve the document, saving `data` first if given (AC5).

get.description: The document's current extraction; 404 until one exists (F5 AC6).

put.description:
Save the reviewer's corrections as a new version (AC4). 409 when the document changed
since `base_version` (AC6); no new version when nothing changed.

post.description: A link to the original file, valid for 5 minutes (AC9).

get.description: Issues found on the document's current extraction (AC2); 404 until one exists.

post.description: Process a FAILED document again with a fresh set of attempts (F3 AC8).

get.description:
Status changes for the caller's workspace only. The membership check (and its
database session) finishes before streaming starts, so no connection is held open.
How many approved documents needed no corrections (AC8).

The workspace's documents matching the text (by keyword and meaning) and filters,
best first; newest first without text (AC1 to AC5).

post.description: Start an upload: returns a signed upload ticket, or the existing duplicate.

Record the uploaded file as a document once it is in storage (AC1, AC4, AC5), and
queue its processing (F3 AC1).
